summary: Frontend-only regression on /bot page after CSS tweak (.tgx-fan-glow: top:42%→45%, width:5%→6%). Login worked with admin creds, /bot loads (redirect through /login then to /bot succeeded). Verified data-testid=fan-glow exists, computed style shows position:absolute with expected geometry, and computed CENTER coordinates fall within the expected tolerance on the fan hub. 5 SVG trace paths (data-testid=bothub-hero > svg > path.tgx-trace) present, 6 bottom-nav tabs (Home, Market, Trade, Asset, Bot, Profile). No console errors captured on /bot page. Screenshot confirms ONE unified pulsing red↔green light sits directly on the fan's center hub (upper-right of the hero image, right of the AI chip).
critical_code_review_comments: Preview-only overlay: the 'Made with Emergent' badge visually overlaps the right half of the bottom nav (covers Asset/Bot/Profile labels) in the preview environment. This is preview-injected, not shipped code — nav-bot click via testid still works when the overlay isn't blocking (direct URL navigation to /bot also works). No action required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The CSS fix for .tgx-fan-glow (top:45%, left:82%, width:6%) is verified. Computed center on a 358x358 hero: cx=~82%, cy=~45%. To re-verify at any time: goto /bot after admin login, then run document.querySelector('[data-testid=fan-glow]').getBoundingClientRect() vs document.querySelector('[data-testid=bothub-hero]').getBoundingClientRect() and compute (cy-heroTop)/heroH ≈ 0.45. Screenshot at /app/test_reports/screenshots/bot_page_full.png shows the unified pulsing glow on the fan hub.
visual_verification_notes: Screenshot confirms the pulsing overlay sits exactly on the fan hub (small fan visible in the upper-right of the HUB X BOT hero, right of the AI chip). No secondary/duplicate light above or below — single merged red↔green pulse.
